subject.title: Suggestion: Atlassian Rovo Dev CLI provider

question: Should CodexBar accept an experimental Rovo Dev provider that uses Atlassian's observed credits endpoint with email and scoped API-token authentication despite the endpoint not being a supported public API?
rationale: Provider coverage is vision-aligned, but accepting and maintaining an undocumented authenticated endpoint, including its site-scoping semantics, requires explicit repository-owner intent that source inspection and tests cannot supply.

options.title: Accept after live proof
options.body: Approve the experimental provider after its conflicts are resolved and an entitled account demonstrates redacted exact-head CodexBar credit fetching and site behavior.

options.title: Wait for supported contract
options.body: Keep the request open but pause the PR until Atlassian publishes a stable usage endpoint or supported non-interactive CLI contract.

options.title: Decline undocumented integration
options.body: Close the implementation direction if maintaining an unsupported credential-bearing endpoint exceeds CodexBar's provider risk tolerance.

recommendation.title: Accept after live proof
recommendation.body: Approve the experimental provider after its conflicts are resolved and an entitled account demonstrates redacted exact-head CodexBar credit fetching and site behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: The repository owner directly repaired the implementation and explicitly reserved the endpoint/auth acceptance decision.
